clips.title: The story
paras: At small Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil holds three night elven scouts in crude iron cages. He sends Horde adventurers to Stonetalon Peak for wilderness reagents to brew a grim forest magic.

Under the Horde's watch, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil practices his craft in Malaka'jin's red-rock defile. When three night elf captives fall into his hands, he chooses a mocking ritual made for his woodland foes instead of ordinary butchery. He sends travelers north into the peaks for thick tree sap, feline whiskers from predatory twilight runners, a shimmering fey dragon scale, and scores of eyes from the local forest coursers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Three little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... What do they call it... Forest magic!

I'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course—can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.
Hurry to Stonetalon Peak, friend, so I can brew some forest magic!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Look at our poor little elf friends. All caged up with no forest to frolic in!
Now were you able to find me some sap? How about the whiskers from the twilight runners? Don't suppose you have that fey dragon scale on you?
And eyes! I'll need so many eyes! You just can't mix up a fierce forest magic brew without a good helping of eyes!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh how happy these little woodland nymphs shall be! We'll make them feel right at home with this special concoction!
